clips.title: The story
paras: Syndicate shadow mages gather Vial of Innocent Blood in the ruins of Durnholde Keep. The Royal Apothecary Society in Tarren Mill seeks it as a catalyst for experimental toxins.

Syndicate shadow mages gather innocent blood in the ruins of Durnholde Keep. The Syndicate's fallen human nobles practice dark arts within the crumbled walls. Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill wants untainted blood for an experimental pacifying agent. He means to use it against the Venture Company in Stonetalon Mountains, and sees the Syndicate's stores as a convenient source.
